stem.text: A student sets up a circuit. The circuit diagram shows how the positive and negative terminals of a voltmeter are connected to the circuit. The voltmeter has an initial reading that is positive.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with a battery, a voltmeter with + and − terminals marked, a thermistor, a light-dependent resistor and fixed resistors.

stem.text: Which changes, if any, in temperature and light intensity would cause the voltmeter reading to **decrease**?
